title_zh: v0.8.5 已发布：版本号展示与更新体验完善，点击查看详情
title_en: v0.8.5 Released: Version display & smoother update feedback — View

items.title_zh: v0.8.5 — 版本号展示与更新交互体验完善
items.title_en: v0.8.5 — Version Display & Smoother Update Feedback
items.body_zh:
• 在设置页「通用」与菜单栏下拉菜单底部清晰展示当前版本号与 Build 号
• 后台静默下载更新期间点击「检查更新」不再无响应，改为明确提示当前进度
• 完整包含应用内「更新与公告」中心、定时静默刷新、未读小圆点及统一反馈邮箱 support@notchmuse.com
items.body_en:
• Added clear version and build number display in Settings → General and at the bottom of the Menu Bar dropdown
• Clicking Check for Updates while a background download is running now shows a clear status message instead of ignoring the click
• Includes the native in-app Updates & Announcements window, quiet background refresh, unread dot, and support@notchmuse.com

items.title_zh: v0.8.4 — 应用内更新公告中心与统一反馈入口
items.title_en: v0.8.4 — In-App Announcements Center & Unified Support
items.body_zh:
• 点击顶部公告条不再跳转浏览器，改为直接打开原生「更新与公告」窗口查看历史版本与平台公告，且公告条常驻不消失
• 新增未读小圆点提示与后台定时静默刷新（每 6 小时及打开设置页时按需更新）
• 更新说明弹窗支持按系统语言自动展示中文/英文并可零延迟一键切换
• 反馈邮箱统一升级为 support@notchmuse.com，并在公告窗口底部内置直达入口
items.body_en:
• Clicking the top announcement bar now opens a native in-app Updates & Announcements window instead of a browser tab, while keeping the banner permanently pinned
• Added a subtle unread dot for new announcements and quiet background refresh (every 6 hours and when reopening Settings)
• Release notes now default to your macOS language with instant one-click EN/ZH switching
• Unified support email to support@notchmuse.com with a direct footer link inside the announcements window

items.title_zh: v0.8.3 — 四平台歌词命中率提升至 90%
items.title_en: v0.8.3 — 90% Lyrics Match Rate Across 4 Players
items.body_zh:
• Apple Music（43% → 90%）、Spotify（58% → 90%）、网易云音乐（45% → 90%）、汽水音乐（44% → 90%）
• 恢复酷狗/QQ 音乐直连并支持逐字时间戳解析，消除 <00:12.34> 异常数字串
• 启动自动静默检查更新 + 设置页独立「自动下载并安装更新」开关
• 刘海/悬浮毛玻璃质感、0.5pt 描边与胶囊工具条升级
items.body_en:
• Apple Music (43% → 90%), Spotify (58% → 90%), NetEase Cloud (45% → 90%), Soda Music (44% → 90%)
• Restored direct Kugou & QQ Music sources and Enhanced LRC word-timestamp parsing
• Automatic launch update checks + independent auto download & install toggle
• Upgraded Notch/Free Floating frosted vibrancy, 0.5pt rim, and capsule hover bar

items.title_zh: v0.8.2 — 应用内自动更新与播放器识别增强
items.body_zh:
• 正式集成 Sparkle 应用内更新机制与 EdDSA 签名校验
• 增强网易云音乐、QQ 音乐、汽水音乐与 Spotify 的播放状态同步
items.body_en:
• Integrated Sparkle in-app updater with EdDSA signature verification
• Improved playback sync across NetEase Cloud, QQ Music, Soda Music, and Spotify

items.title_zh: v0.8.1 — 自由悬浮模式与时间轴精准同步
items.title_en: v0.8.1 — Free Floating Mode & Precision Timing Sync
items.body_zh:
• 支持桌面自由悬浮词条、单行/双行切换与手动微调时间偏移
• 优化菜单栏歌词渲染性能与低功耗表现
items.body_en:
• Added Free Floating desktop lyrics, 1/2-line modes, and manual timing offset
• Optimized menu-bar rendering and low-power idle behavior
